plainTranslation: A supportive blend of feeling and stability. The Saturn person offers reliability; the Moon person softens the Saturn person's edges, and it's there without strain. Failure mode: under-using it - the steadiness exists but you don't lean on it. Build the routines and commitments that make the emotional safety concrete.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry aspect material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
